evidence_gaps: Fresh sanitised runtime forensics generated within two hours.
Money-weighted realised NET P&L by strategy and chain after all trading fees, slippage, price impact, gas or priority fees, tips, consumed rent and profit share.
Decision-time quote, final simulation, broadcast, landing, confirmation and exit linkage for each attempted trade.
Separate STRATEGY/MARKET and EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE loss and failure counts, costs and rates.
Solana quote age, Jupiter route, price impact, compute units, priority fee, signature fee, tips, token-account rent treatment and sellability outcomes.
EVM effective gas, approval/wrap costs, transfer-tax behaviour, revert rate, inclusion delay, MEV deterioration and final received amounts.
Prospective out-of-sample observations with no look-ahead leakage, including rejected and no-trade opportunities.
Notional-weighted exposure, drawdown, tail loss, concentration and regime breakdowns.

Before promotion: statistically credible positive money-weighted net P&L with a positive lower confidence bound, complete cost attribution, acceptable execution-failure rate, stable results across regimes and independent human approval.

proposals.downside_risk: Longer evaluation windows and fewer apparent opportunities; outcome matching errors could bias results unless unresolved observations fail closed.

evidence.detail: Scorecards correctly state that quote simulations are research evidence and prohibit promotion.
Current aggregation primarily counts executable simulations and quote-simulated net amounts, not later realised executable outcomes.

proposals.expected_effect: Produces defensible net-P&L, drawdown and cost attribution by strategy, chain and notional bucket while separating market losses from infrastructure failures.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 200 independently timestamped eligible observations per chain, 30 days, 20 realised-equivalent exits, multiple volatility/congestion regimes, and complete cost/failure attribution.
proposals.rationale: Durable money-weighted decisions require time-aligned out-of-sample outcomes net of all costs and failed attempts, not signal counts or simulated win frequency.
proposals.shadow_test: In SHADOW only, freeze each decision-time quote and notional, sample executable exit quotes through the strategy horizon, subtract LP/router fees, slippage, measured impact, EVM gas or Solana signature/priority/tip/rent costs, and assign failures to STRATEGY_MARKET or EXECUTION_INFRASTRUCTURE. Stop the hypothesis if money-weighted net P&L is non-positive, lower confidence bound is non-positive, unresolved outcome rate exceeds 5%, or infrastructure failure cost exceeds 10% of gross edge.

proposals.downside_risk: A strict adapter may classify most signals as ineligible; sparse or illiquid mints may require a substantially longer observation period.

evidence.detail: Solana leader events intentionally receive zero current gross edge, liquidity and sellability because no contemporaneous executable future-return evidence exists.
The live gate relies on reconstructed historical and recent median leader returns.
Solana policy separately caps fee ratio, impact/slippage and disables Jito tips, but configured assumptions require runtime calibration.

proposals.expected_effect: Determines whether copied signals retain positive executable edge after delay, Jupiter impact, priority fees, token-account/rent effects and failed exits.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 150 eligible Solana signals across 30 days, 30 closed shadow paths, at least 10 leaders and 20 mints, including congested and low-liquidity periods.
proposals.rationale: Historical leader returns and defensive execution limits do not prove positive follower edge at the follower's delayed entry, size and exit path.
proposals.shadow_test: Capture decision-time buy and full-size sell quotes at the intended follower notional, observed price impact, quote age, estimated signature/compute/priority fees, refundable versus consumed rent, and subsequent exit quotes. Compare against a no-trade baseline. Stop if money-weighted net is non-positive, median edge turns negative after a 2x observed-cost stress, sellability failures exceed 2%, or quote-to-executable deterioration consumes over 50% of forecast edge.

proposals.downside_risk: Forecast selection bias and regime overfitting could suppress valid trades; no live gate should be derived until prospective evidence exists.

evidence.detail: Entry validation checks signal age, buy quote, leader-price deterioration, sellability and round-trip loss.
BUY gas is estimated or reconciled, but the entry decision does not require a positive forward expected return after round-trip costs.
Atomic EVM cycles separately require quoted gross edge to cover conservative gas and configured minimum net profit.

proposals.expected_effect: Reduces economically negative copy entries while preserving the existing sellability and execution protections.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 200 prospective EVM signals, 50 closed shadow outcomes, 30 days, three gas-price regimes and no leader contributing more than 20% of notional.
proposals.rationale: A sellable token with bounded round-trip loss can still have negative expected follower P&L. Copy selection should be researched against executable forward edge rather than historical wallet rank or win count.
proposals.shadow_test: Shadow-score each leader BUY using only pre-entry features, then re-quote at the intended wallet size and evaluate time-aligned exits after router fees, transfer taxes, price impact, gas, approval costs, slippage and execution failures. Stop if prospective money-weighted net P&L is non-positive, the lower confidence bound is non-positive, or results depend on one leader, asset or gas regime.

proposals.downside_risk: State changes between simulation and inclusion, MEV and fee spikes can still erase edge or cause failure.

evidence.detail: Wallet-specific simulation includes conservative gas reserve and rejects edges below minimum net profit.
The exact transaction receives a mandatory final eth_call before signing.
Scanner rejects non-positive gross edge and performs a 2x-size impact check before wallet-specific execution simulation.

proposals.expected_effect: Continues rejecting routes whose quoted edge cannot cover conservative gas or whose final transaction simulation fails.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 eligible atomic candidates over 14 days across each enabled EVM chain and low, medium and high gas regimes.
proposals.rationale: These are appropriate execution safeguards and should not be weakened, although architecture alone does not demonstrate profitable opportunity frequency.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay observed candidates without submission and compare selection-time quote, final simulated minimum output and next-block executable quote, including gas and failure costs. Fail if realised-equivalent net is non-positive or simulation-to-inclusion deterioration exceeds the reserved edge in more than 5% of eligible observations.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any strategy to CANARY or LIVE from this review.
rejected_ideas.reason: Runtime forensics are missing and the available evidence is architecture-only.

rejected_ideas.idea: Optimise leader selection or thresholds for raw win count.
rejected_ideas.reason: Win count ignores money weighting, loss magnitude and chain-specific execution costs.

rejected_ideas.idea: Relax sellability, liquidity, slippage, simulation or fee protections to increase trade frequency.
rejected_ideas.reason: More fills without positive executable edge would increase adverse selection and tail-loss exposure.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat every losing trade as strategy failure.
rejected_ideas.reason: Correctly executed negative market outcomes are STRATEGY/MARKET losses, while landed-invalid transactions, RPC/quote failures, blocked exits and reconciliation faults are EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository contains meaningful fail-closed execution protections, but no fresh runtime evidence supports profitability or promotion. Solana leader-copy losses must be classified as STRATEGY/MARKET when transactions execute correctly but cost-adjusted exits lose money; landed-invalid transactions, quote/RPC failures and blocked exits are EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures. EVM atomic cycles have wallet-specific gas simulation and atomic minimum-output protection, while EVM leader-copy entry validation does not establish positive forward net edge. Solana SHADOW features deliberately lack current executable edge, so Solana strategy claims remain unproven.
